# unifi_switch_stacks (Data Source)

Lists switch stacks on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List switch stacks on the site via the Official API.
data "unifi_switch_stacks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing switch stacks.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `stacks` (Attributes List) The switch stacks defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks))

<a id="nestedatt--stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the switch stack.
- `json` (String) The full switch stack record, including nested lags, serialized as a JSON string.
- `member_device_ids` (List of String) The UUIDs of the devices that are members of the stack.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the switch stack entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `name` (String) The switch stack name.
